name: val-manager
description: 无畏契约（VALORANT）电竞经理 — a browser-based VCT esports manager game

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/precompress.mjs && npm run build:server
scripts.dossier: python3 scripts/fetch_vlr_profiles.py && python3 scripts/fetch_vlr_staff.py && python3 scripts/fetch_liquipedia_faces.py && python3 scripts/fetch_legend_faces.py && python3 scripts/fetch_faces.py && python3 scripts/build_dossier.py
scripts.people: python3 scripts/build_people_registry.py && python3 scripts/fetch_vlr_people.py && python3 scripts/fetch_spike_people.py && python3 scripts/build_people.py && python3 scripts/fetch_liquipedia_people.py && python3 scripts/build_people.py && python3 scripts/fetch_people_faces.py && python3 scripts/build_dossier.py && python3 scripts/build_retired.py
